title: no way to get watch face installed through playstore-apps on phone...etc...
symptom: Since the dev version, the AAPS watch face does not get installed via the Play Store app on the phone; no AAPS is displayed, so there is no way to install it. Building the AAPS APK is fine, the wear.apk is there and not empty, but the watch face does not appear on the watch.
cause: The cause was identified as a problem in the build process of the dev version, which was later fixed by a change in the APK build process (referenced as #198).
fix: The fix was to restore the APK build process via pull request #198, which resolved the issue for users.
evidence_quote: Apk build process will be restored with #198. @AdrianLxM, many thanks for your work!
